title: DATEDIFF counts boundaries crossed: one day across New Year is 1 year, a whole year inside one calendar year is 0
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "across", DATEDIFF ( DATE ( 2011, 12, 31 ), DATE ( 2012, 1, 1 ), YEAR ), "inside", DATEDIFF ( DATE ( 2011, 1, 1 ), DATE ( 2011, 12, 31 ), YEAR ) )

source.quote: DATEDIFF counts the interval boundaries between Date1 and Date2. It does not count complete intervals.
source.supports: the page gives exactly these two expressions, returning 1 and 0
